rules.claims: Do not overwrite another run's active claim; verify the previous run stopped before resuming an unreleased claim.
rules.blocked_runs: With unchanged prerequisites and no useful independent task, stop quietly without filler commits or repeated source searches.

integrated.evidence: SOURCE_AUDIT + LOCAL_TEST_ONLY; eight audit tests; no native comparison proof
CONNECTED_DRIVE_METADATA; search coverage control failed; no verified target binary
ORIGINAL_CODE + LOCAL_TEST_ONLY; 19 relay tests; 29 canonical tests; no SOCKS5/device/historical EOF validation
integrated.input: Preserved local CF18-03 original draft; no remote packet commit. Exact input hashes in INTEGRATION.md.

lanes.scope: Review new lane packets against current main and integrate supported code/evidence; maintain shared knowledge and this queue.
prerequisites: A meaningful new submitted packet or source evidence
lanes.next_action: Review the next eligible packet. Do not repeat unchanged integration/status commits.

lanes.scope: Exact original incoming splitter: RX caller, magic load/compare and byte order, length/cursor bounds, fragmentation/coalescence and error branches.
prerequisites: Verified 2018 libapollo.so private source link, actual hash and ISA from CF18-04
lanes.ready_when: The source receipt is independently verified; then submit a bounded native trace and original strict-parser proposal justified only by observed rules.
lanes.do_not: Repeat the prefix-model audit or infer native semantics from passing Python tests.

lanes.scope: Exact original ACK/session/decryption validation: type dispatch, TLV bounds, field correlation, negotiated key modes and state transitions.
prerequisites: Verified 2018 libapollo.so private source link, actual hash and ISA from CF18-04
lanes.ready_when: The source receipt is independently verified; then trace receiver branch predicates and propose only supported validators/tests.
lanes.do_not: Guess echoed/generated fields, construct an assumed valid ACK, or duplicate CF18-01 framing work.

lanes.scope: Propose an original bounded RFC 1928 negotiation/CONNECT adapter for the canonical passive relay, in this lane's packet only.
acceptance: Disabled by default; no automatic listener, device test or ACK generation.
Use independent synthetic SOCKS5 fixtures and localhost-only tests; handle short/fragmented negotiation, unsupported methods/commands/address types and bounded lengths/deadlines.
Preserve bytes buffered after CONNECT negotiation and leave the relay's two directions intact.
Dispatch only exact known game IP AND port to loopback; unrelated requests must be returned to the original bridge's unchanged passthrough handling, never silently dropped or globally redirected.
One run must cap accepted diagnostic connections at 4-16; retain UUID run/connection IDs and metadata-only lifecycle logs.
Do not claim historical bridge, PCAPdroid or Termux compatibility without recovered source and actual evidence.
lanes.next_action: Read canonical relay and tests at the integrated commit; submit one tested adapter packet and integration recipe under CF18-03 only. Do not re-submit the integrated core.

lanes.scope: Verify original 2018 package/library identity and retrieve only required native/managed/probe/report sources privately.
prerequisites: A new actual authorized private target locator, source bundle or changed retrieval capability
lanes.ready_when: A new locator or independently retrievable source is supplied; read metadata, verify package identity, calculate actual hashes and ISA, then provide a rights-safe source receipt.
lanes.do_not: Repeat capped full asset listings or infer absence from failed search; never substitute the 9.99 APK.
